name: SQLite MCP Server
shortDescription: Query, inspect, and analyze local SQLite databases, .db/.sqlite files with schema reflection and SQL operations.
longDescription: Allow AI assistants to open and inspect local SQLite database files, execute queries, create tables, run analytical aggregates, and auto-generate schema diagrams.
author: modelcontextprotocol

tools.name: read_query
tools.description: Execute a SELECT query against the SQLite database.

tools.name: write_query
tools.description: Execute INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE operations.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the SQLite database.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get table schema definition and column constraints.

installSteps.title: Configure Path to Database
installSteps.description: Provide the `--db-path` argument pointing to your `.db` file.
